LOCKED Jinn error model (task 2-4, whole-hog rewrite):
- Declare: `err FileError`+indented variants (existing).
- RAISE: `err NotFound` (variant of an err enum). HARD MIGRATE off prefix `!`-raise and `! sentinel` ints.
- QUATERNARY (extends ternary `cond ? a ! b`): `e ? ok_arm ! nothing_arm !! err_arm`. `$`=unwrapped success value in ? arm. `err`=current error value in !! arm (`!! err` propagates, `!! log(err)` inspects).
- DEFAULTS: `foo()` == `foo() ? $ !! err` (implicit propagate). `foo() !! 0` == `foo() ? $ !! 0`.
- `! E` in SIGNATURE = error-union annotation (kept), checked R1 + From. `! E` => returns Result of R,E (desugar_bang_ret added in resolve.rs).
- Signatures fully inferred; returns/!E optional.
- PROPAGATION always legal; fallibility INFERRED. Only main unhandled => nonzero exit + printed err (no caller-obligation hard error).
- Lexer: tokenize `!!`. Parser: pratt accepts e ? a ! b !! c uniformly; typer decides ok/nothing/err by type (Result/Option/bool).
- REMOVE `?>` operator + PendingPropagate machinery.
- Tasks: 2-4a spec doc; 2-4b lexer !! + err-raise parse; 2-4c quaternary parse+desugar; 2-4d typer (err-raise, $/err binding, infer fallibility, R1-R6 SCC fixpoint, From graph); 2-4e codegen; 2-4f migrate corpus + conformance tests/error_effects.rs.
Already added: src/typer/resolve.rs desugar_bang_ret + auto_wrap_ok/auto_unwrap_result helpers in call/method_call.rs + tail auto-wrap in stmt/block.rs.

quaternary_design.value: Task 2-4-3 quaternary parser. Add AST node Expr::Quaternary(subject, Option<ok_arm>, Option<nothing_arm>, Option<err_arm>, Span). Parse in parse_ternary: after subject `e`, on Token::Query parse arms. `?` ok arm, `!` nothing arm, `!!` err arm. Each arm optional. If only `?...!...` with no `!!`, AND subject is boolean-ish, it is still Ternary — BUT we cannot know type at parse time. DECISION: parse `e ? a ! b` as Ternary (unchanged), and ONLY produce Quaternary when a `!!` arm is present. The `!!`-less Option success/empty case `find() ? use($) ! none()` is parsed as Ternary and reinterpreted by typer when subject is Option (task 2-4-4). `$` parses as Expr::Placeholder, `err` parses as Expr::Ident("err") — binding resolved in lowering (2-4-4). Multiline arm form: newline+indent then `?`/`!`/`!!` lines. Need to handle INDENT/DEDENT/NEWLINE tokens.

structured_concurrency_design.value: Task 2-5 DONE: docs/structured-concurrency.md. `together [name]` scope block: dispatch/spawn inside register as non-daemon children; join on block exit. spawn in scope = scope-owned actor (non-daemon, auto-stop+drain at exit = first-class stop-and-drain). Cancellation: child error or `stop <scope>` cancels cooperatively at suspension points; defers+Perceus drops run; uncatchable Cancelled, not in error unions. Cancelled actors skip drain (stop=graceful, cancel=fast). Errors: first error wins, siblings cancelled, scope is fallible expression (union via SCC fixpoint), implicit propagation + From + multiline quaternary !! arm on block. Actor handler errors propagate to owning scope (error-effects §8 boundary); daemon actors unchanged. L3 escape check: coroutines can't outlive scope. Runtime sketch: jinn_scope_t, coro gains scope ptr + cancelled flag; no changes to active_coros/*main epilogue/C ABI. supervisor decl (parser-only, dormant) = future sugar over scopes. Conformance plan table included for impl task.

- kv.get returns Option of val_ty: monomorphize_enum("Option",{T:val_ty}) -> Type::Enum(opt). KvGet HIR node must carry val_ty + opt enum so codegen builds Some/Nothing. task_2-31-7_design.value:
Task 2-31-7 group-by aggregates. DESIGN: method-based, fits existing aggregate surface (sum/avg/min/max/distinct are methods scanning records in analytics.rs).
Surface: store.group(keyField).agg(valField) where agg in {sum,avg,min,max,count}. count takes no valField: store.group(keyField).count().
Returns Vec<Tuple([KeyTy, ValueTy])>. KeyTy = group field type (String/I64). ValueTy: avg->F64, count->I64, sum/min/max-> I64 or F64 per field.
AST: new Expr::StoreGroup(store, keyField, agg_method, Option<valField>, span). Parser: detect method 'group' returning a pending group then chained method. SIMPLER: handle in store_methods.rs as method 'group' producing intermediate, but chained call is awkward.
ALTERNATIVE chosen: single method form store.group(keyField, valField, "avg") is ugly. 
DECISION: parse store.group(keyField) as Expr that captures following .agg(valField). Implement via new HIR ExprKind::StoreGroup(store, key_field, agg:String, val_field:Option<Symbol>). Typer recognizes pattern Call(Field(Call(Field(store,'group'),[key]), agg), [val]).
Codegen: emit_store_group in analytics.rs - scan records, hashmap keyed by group field -> accumulator(count,sum,min,max), then build Vec of tuples.
column.c leveraged only conceptually; in-memory scan reuses store_load_records like distinct.

task_2-31-8_design.value:
Task 2-31-8 richer where filters. ARCHITECTURE NOTE: filters flow parser->ast::StoreFilter{field,op:BinOp,value,extra:Vec<(LogicalOp,StoreFilterCond)>} -> hir mirror -> MIR encodes everything into mangled fn name __store_query_STORE__FIELD__OP__lop__field__op... + args -> codegen decodes name in query.rs/delete.rs/mutation.rs/read.rs/lifecycle.rs and calls eval_store_filter (store_filter.rs) which does store_compare_field per type.
DECISION: extend flat model. Replace BinOp op with new ast::FilterPred enum {Cmp(BinOp), In(n_values), Between, Contains, StartsWith}. Carry extra value exprs. Mangle pred into name. eval_store_filter/store_compare_field gain In/Between/Contains/StartsWith cases. between uses 'between LO and HI' but parser must NOT treat that 'and' as logical chain. in uses '[a,b,c]' Array literal -> lower each elem as arg. Grouping: parser supports parenthesized (a and b) groups but only pure-conjunction/disjunction flattening; mixed precedence errors clearly.
KEY FILES: src/parser/stmt/store.rs (parse_store_filter, parse_filter_op), src/ast.rs (StoreFilter/StoreFilterCond/new FilterPred), src/hir/mod.rs (mirror + encode_store_set_call), src/typer/stmt/filter.rs (lower_store_filter, flatten_filter_expr), src/mir/lower/store_expr.rs + store_stmt.rs (name mangling), src/codegen/mir_codegen/store/{query,delete,mutation,read,lifecycle}.rs (decode), src/codegen/store_filter.rs (eval_store_filter + store_compare_field).

SOLUTION: parse `join` contextually in parser/stmt/dispatch.rs `_ => Token::Ident(kw)` arm (alongside destroy/restore/save/compact): `"join" if !matches!(peek_at(1), LParen|Dot)` -> Stmt::Join. So `join w` = join statement, `join(a,b)`/`join.x` = expression. Stmt::Join(Expr,Span) exists in ast+hir wired everywhere (typer requires ActorRef, MIR __join, magic.rs GEPs mailbox field 3). Lesson: new statement keywords that collide with stdlib identifiers must be contextual, not reserved.

task_2-6-5-3_findings.value: Task 2-6-5-3 CORE PROBLEM: scope error model carries a bare i64 tag word. emit_scope_build_err (magic.rs:416) reconstructs Result::Err{tag=word} with NO payload. WORKS only when child err enum == enclosing err enum AND fieldless. BREAKS when (a) enclosing err type != child err type (needs From conversion), or (b) err variant has a payload (Wrapped(Boom)) -> reconstructing {tag=1} no-payload produces garbage + codegen panic at values.rs:399 (expected IntValue). Child task Return(val) coerce_to_i64 + jinn_scope_record_current_error loses payload. FIX DESIGN: child must propagate to ENCLOSING fn's Result-err type (apply From at child site, like propagate_err_value with real ret_ty), then BOX the full Result-err value on heap, record pointer(i64) on scope; scope re-raise loads boxed value back and returns it. Handles arbitrary payloads + From.

task_2-19_lamp_design.value: Task 2-19 = lamp (Jinn package manager) spec. Deliverable: docs/lamp.md technical spec. CURRENT STATE: src/pkg.rs (Package/SemVer/Dependency, project.jn manifest parse), src/lock.rs (Lockfile nested entries name/url/version/commit), src/driver/cmd_pkg.rs (git-based fetch/update/publish/package via git tags + tar.gz). Single binary jinnc with subcommands. KEY DESIGN PILLARS for spec: (1) one quintessential curated package per facet (no npm sprawl) — std/libjn/ext tiers; ext = community packages vendored under jinn project purview. (2) supply-chain security first: lockfile w/ content hashes, sigstore-style signing, capability/effect manifests, vendoring, reproducible builds, SBOM. (3) binary library format (.jnlib): compiled MIR/object + interface metadata + debug variant. (4) one tool `lamp` (not jinnc) doing package/install/publish/version/scaffold, server (decentralized/distributed), bug tracking + changelog/patch-notes/close. AVOID npm/yarn/bun/npx fragmentation. Single tool, single lockfile, single manifest (project.jn).

lamp_transitive_dep_model.value: lamp.md §5.6 (new): how a .jnb binary's transitive deps work. DECISION: binaries reference deps by content-address (option c: packed-by-reference, deduplicated), NEVER fat-bundle (rejected: kills dedup, unpatchable CVEs, Maven shaded-jar antipattern). Mechanism: (1) .jnb carries deps.descriptor = triples (range, iface-hash=used-surface BLAKE3, built-version), NO dep bytes. (2) Resolver folds binary ranges into ONE global MVS solution -> single-version unification holds across binary boundary (fixes old §3.4 'leaf pinned to exact version' which contradicted §3.1). (3) ABI check: selected X's used-surface iface hash must match what binary compiled against -> fast path no rebuild; mismatch -> rebuild from source if shipped, else per-edge pin to matching X, else hard error. (4) used-surface hash (§5.6.6) = hash only of X symbols A's MIR references, so unrelated X additions don't force rebuilds. (5) genuine incompat -> hard error, escape hatch requires-isolated (namespaced dup copies, SBOM-reported). (6) lib=always by-ref; bin/app=final-link packs unified closure ONCE at leaf after unification. (7) lock gains iface + via + pin(abi|isolated) fields. Also rewrote §3.4, §5.2 structure, §11 Maven bullet, §12 phases 6&9, §13 summary, conformance tests.
